answer: Neighbor quorum. Five unrelated neighbors vouch for each newcomer, filing signatures in a public lagoon. Each neighbor locks 40 credits and backs at most two per epoch. A proven fake burns its 70-credit bond and all five locks, sending a plume over the lagoon. Rented neighbors fall to their nadir too and cannot vouch again. 1,000 fakes need 2,500 neighbors and 270,000 credits for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents lock 70 once and keep their bond.
